dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.axial_tapering: Gradual, symmetrical tapering of the 2D lateral profile from the mid-body toward the posterior peduncle.

surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.global_grayscale_baseline: Mature white; high median pixel intensity consistent across the visible dorsal surface.

high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.localized_point_contrast_disruptions: Multiple dark, longitudinal linear markings visible along the posterior dorsal midline.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Healed linear marks or rake markings visible on the posterior third of the dorsal surface.
other_distinctive_markers: Distinct, dark circular blowhole aperture visible at the anterior dorsal midline.
